shortDescription: A 13-week Russian squat specialization cycle — brutal high-volume base phase followed by heavy peaking, designed to add 40-100 lbs to your squat
descriptionHtml: A 13-week Russian squat specialization cycle — brutal high-volume base phase followed by heavy peaking, designed to add 40-100 lbs to your squat
author: Sergey Smolov

exercises.notes: **Intro Microcycle.** Ramping sets to prepare for the base mesocycle.

descriptions: **Intro Microcycle.** Ramping sets to prepare for the base mesocycle.

exercises.notes: **Intro Week 2.** Light singles of 5 to test recovery before the base mesocycle.

descriptions: **Intro Week 2.** Light singles of 5 to test recovery before the base mesocycle.

exercises.notes: **Base Mesocycle.** 4 squat sessions per week. Weight increases +20lb in Week 4 and +10lb more in Week 5.

**Test Week.** Rest 2-3 days, then build to a new squat 1RM.
